charts.title: Heteroplasmic chrM sites
charts.caveat: ClinVar and gnomAD v3.1 (chrM sites) annotate the calls in step 20. MITOMAP (mitomap.org) has the curated disease status of mtDNA variants; it is a manual lookup, as it refuses scripted requests.
